seo.title: Territory maps, autocomplete, and geolocation · Chase Teichmann
seo.description: At Actifai I helped build territory management for the door-to-door sales app, so each team gets its own area, and I work on the location and address features around it.

sections.label: Territories
sections.html:
Actifai’s door-to-door sales app puts addresses on a map for reps to work, and territory management lets managers give each team its own area.

With teammates, I built both sides of it: the drawing tools managers use to outline clusters of addresses, assigning each territory to reps by user group, and the view where reps see their own territory.

sections.label: Map clustering
sections.html: The address map groups nearby addresses into clusters, so reps and managers can read it at any zoom level. I improved clustering performance across zoom levels, by 60% on average.

sections.label: Location tracking
sections.html: I made rep location tracking more accurate and permission-aware. The app asks for location at the right moment and handles a rep who says no.

sections.label: Address autocomplete
sections.html: Every service order in Actifai’s online shop needs an address. Google Places autocomplete gets customers to a valid service address with less typing, so fewer orders come in with bad addresses.
